\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-75},
  title = {The test suite also runs on Windows in CI},
  date = {2026-10-06},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Testing Strategy, CI/CD},
  participants = {@lukas2510; @kadameit found the Windows failures},
  decision = {CI runs the whole test suite on \texttt{windows-\allowbreak{}latest} as well as on Linux, as the required job \texttt{Tests (Windows)}.
Coverage and the test reports still come from the Linux job.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item The same job, not required: a red check that does not block is one people learn to merge past.
\item Emulate Windows in the Linux suite: covers only the failure modes it was written for.
\item Rely on contributors who develop on Windows: a failure is found after the merge, by one person.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} One of us develops on Windows, and NFR-06 asks that a clean clone reproduces the pipeline.
On Windows it did not: JSON artefacts came out with CRLF line endings and a different hash.
The job's first run also found a failure nobody knew of, paths that span two drives.
The cost is a longer wait for the last required check of a pull request.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI traced the two known Windows failures to their causes, reproduced one end to end and recommended the required job, which Lukas chose.
The fixes, the tests written to fail first and the analysis of the failures the new job found were AI's.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-06 on issue \#84 and on the review of PR \#73 and PR \#75.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/84}{Issue \#84}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/85}{PR \#85}, the \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/actions/runs/37438994409}{failing run} before the fix, \texttt{.\allowbreak{}github/\allowbreak{}workflows/\allowbreak{}ci.\allowbreak{}yml}.},
